name: openagenda
description: Display your OpenAgenda data on your WordPress site

scripts.start: npm run start:styles & npm run start:scripts
scripts.build: npm run build:styles & npm run build:scripts
scripts.start:scripts: wp-scripts start admin.js customizer.js event-map.js filters.js fontawesome.js leaflet.js main.js media-uploader.js timings.js widgets.js --source-path=assets/src/js --output-path=assets/js
scripts.build:scripts: wp-scripts build admin.js customizer.js event-map.js filters.js fontawesome.js leaflet.js main.js media-uploader.js timings.js widgets.js --source-path=assets/src/js --output-path=assets/js
scripts.start:styles: npm run start:styles:style & npm run start:styles:admin & npm run start:styles:legacy & npm run start:styles:leaflet
scripts.build:styles: npm run build:styles:style & npm run build:styles:admin & npm run build:styles:legacy & npm run build:styles:leaflet

author: Vincent Dubroeucq
